feed.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary: Edil and Daniela have been suggested as suitable candidates for the role of BIP editors. The recommendation is based on positive online interactions, including collaborative work within the BIPs repository, as well as in-person meetings. These experiences have provided insight into their capabilities and suitability for the position.
